title: Adult Mouse Liver Dissociation Protocol on Ice
author: Andrew Potter
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yd2fs8e

steps.title: Dissect liver and keep on ice
steps.instruction: Dissect out mouse liver tissue and immediately immerse/transport it in ice‑cold PBS.

steps.title: Mince tissue on ice
steps.instruction: Place tissue on a petri dish on ice with sterile forceps, remove excess DPBS using a pipette, and mince thoroughly with a razor blade while manipulating with forceps for about 2 minutes until a fine paste is obtained.

steps.title: Resuspend tissue in trypsin mix
steps.instruction: Add 18 mg of minced tissue to 1 mL trypsin enzyme mix in a tube and shake vigorously to resuspend the tissue.

steps.title: Digest at 4 °C with intermittent shaking
steps.instruction: Rotate the tube on a Fisher tube rotator at 4 °C for 3.5 hours; every 45 minutes (4 times total) stop rotation briefly and shake the tube vigorously to resuspend the tissue.

steps.title: Dilute digest with cold DPBS
steps.instruction: After digestion, transfer the mixture to a 15 mL conical tube, add 10 mL ice‑cold DPBS to dilute the trypsin, and resuspend the digest.

steps.title: Pellet cells and tissue chunks
steps.instruction: Spin the tube at 300 g for 5 minutes at 4 °C and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Collect released cells on filter
steps.instruction: Transfer the majority of the supernatant to a filter and rinse.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 75 % of the supernatant (containing released cells) onto a 30 µm filter placed in a 50 mL conical tube.
Rinse the filter with 6 mL ice‑cold PBS containing 0.04 % BSA.
Save the filter and the flow‑through for the next steps.

steps.title: Enzymatic treatment of tissue clumps
steps.instruction: Add bacillus licheniformis enzyme mix to remaining clumps and incubate on ice with periodic shaking and trituration.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL bacillus licheniformis enzyme mix to the tissue clumps at the bottom of the tube.
Incubate on ice, shaking every minute and triturating 10 times every 2 minutes for an additional 15 minutes (total protocol time 3 h 45 min) until most clumps are broken up.

steps.title: Filter remaining digest
steps.instruction: Pass the entire digest through the same filter and rinse.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the entire volume of digest to the same 30 µm filter.
Rinse the filter with 5 mL ice‑cold PBS/0.04 % BSA.
Collect the flow‑through into a 15 mL conical tube.

steps.title: Second low‑speed spin
steps.instruction: Spin the collected flow‑through at 300 g for 5 minutes at 4 °C and remove supernatant, leaving approximately 100 µL in the tube.

steps.title: RBC lysis
steps.instruction: Lyse residual red blood cells and resuspend cells in cold buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL RBC lysis buffer, triturate 20 times, and incubate on ice for 2 minutes.
Add 5 mL ice‑cold PBS/0.04 % BSA and resuspend the cells.

steps.title: Pellet cells after lysis
steps.instruction: Spin at 1800 RPM (low‑speed) for 3 minutes at 4 °C to pellet cells while leaving most debris in the supernatant.

steps.title: Final cell suspension and counting
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells, count, and adjust concentration for downstream platforms.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in ~100 µL ice‑cold PBS/0.04 % BSA.
Count cells using a hemocytometer with trypan blue and adjust concentration to 1,000 cells/µL for Chromium or 100 cells/µL for Drop‑Seq.

steps.title: Settle tissue chunks
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells and any remaining tissue in ice‑cold DPBS, transfer to a 1.5 mL tube, and let chunks settle on ice for 1 minute (released cells remain in supernatant).

steps.title: Final filtration and collection
steps.instruction: Pass the supernatant through a new filter and rinse.

substeps.instruction: Add the supernatant to a new 30 µm filter placed in a 50 mL conical tube.
Rinse the filter with 7 mL ice‑cold PBS/0.04 % BSA.
Transfer the flow‑through to a 15 mL conical tube.
